smith-machine-deadlift.criteria: Low start, fixed bar path, hip-width stance, overhand grip and coordinated hip/knee extension. Demonstration uses a vertical-rail machine permitting floor-height plates.

smith-machine-romanian-deadlift.criteria: Standing start, overhand grip, hip hinge and softly bent knees held constant; controlled descent along fixed rails and return to upright.

smith-machine-stiff-leg-deadlift.criteria: Standing repetition starts after setup; fixed slight knee bend, hip hinge, bar close to legs, controlled return without relaxing at bottom. Knees straighter than modeled Romanian version, not locked.

limits: Procedural demonstration; illustrative proportions, range and eight-second timing. Vertical-rail machine variant with visible safety stops, not a product replica; unracking/reracking not shown. Stylized shorts without fabric simulation; sampled bar/body clearance is not exhaustive collision or biomechanical certification. Physical-device and production verification pending.
